description: October 24 birthday meaning: Libra or Scorpio cusp, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, October 24 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Libra or Scorpio. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 24 birthday
paragraphs: Scorpio season usually opens around October 24, although in some years and at some times of day the Sun is still in late Libra. In most years it sits at zero degrees of Scorpio, in the Pluto-ruled first decan. The birthday number 6 adds devotion to family and friends, giving a protective, intensely loyal temperament with a diplomat's lingering polish.

By noon UTC on October 24, the Sun has normally reached roughly 0° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Pluto, the first of three. The cusp between Libra and Scorpio, around October 22 to October 24, places charm next to intensity. The Sun leaves a cardinal air sign for a fixed water sign at a moment that drifts from year to year, so which one you are depends on the year, hour and place of your birth. A properly calculated chart gives the answer. Traditionally, people near this line blend Libra's social grace with Scorpio's depth and focus. They are often described as magnetic and perceptive, pleasant on the surface and quietly determined underneath, with more going on than they show.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 24 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 24 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 24 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 24 is the 297th day of the year (298th in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 30 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 24 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 24 is also the birthday of Wayne Rooney (1985), Drake (1986) and PewDiePie (1989).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 24?
faq.answer: October 24 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Libra or Scorpio on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Scorpio. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 24 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 24?
faq.answer: By October 24 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 24?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 24 birthday are Wayne Rooney (1985), Drake (1986) and PewDiePie (1989). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
